extends_policy: additive only - no key of the original design token file is redefined here, so that file stays byte-identical and the colour ruling that governs it still holds. This file adds the depth, glow, type-scale and motion tokens the commercial-client pass needs.

source_refs.fonts_latin: assets/fonts/Rajdhani-{Medium,SemiBold,Bold}.ttf (SIL OFL 1.1, added this stage; latin letters, numerals and units only)
source_refs.icons_added: assets/ui/biz/icons/lucide_*.svg (Lucide, ISC plus MIT for the Feather-derived subset; normalised to white and 1.75 stroke)

notes: gold stays the only accent for normal actions; red stays reserved for danger and errors, because the governing colour ruling fixes focus equals accent equals #E0B46A and the design's own line forbids the danger colour on a normal deploy button

nothing in this file may introduce money balances, battle ratings, power scores, network player availability, unsupported battle capacity or cross-nation lineups: those stay in the original file's forbidden_static_mock_values and are never rendered
performance_policy stays HOLD_BY_USER; this pass makes no performance claim
